notes.title: Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together! Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Youtubers!

At UPLAY Online, [b]we are paying close attention to your feedback about Youtubers Life 3[/b]. We believe we have understood the source of the complaints and we want to address them as much as possible, while always keeping the essence of the game intact. To achieve this,[b] we have outlined a roadmap that will take us to the launch of version 1.0.[/b]

We understand that you want to enjoy an offline gameplay experience, closer to the first two games, while still keeping the competitive and online spirit of Youtubers Life 3. For this reason, we are planning a set of new features with a common goal: to add more depth and richness to the single-player experience. In particular, we want to expand the content in events beyond online interaction. Players will have more motivations to attend events and participate in the activities they offer. These are the main new features we are working on:

[b]Event changes[/b]
The event calendar will be removed, and there will be new events available to attend at any given time, without having to wait until the next day. In addition, a wide variety of new activities will be added. Some will be locked depending on your karma or your relationship with the organizing brand. You’ll be able to get exclusive news or interview famous characters.

[b]Karma system[/b]
Your choices matter. Most of the actions you take in the game will have ethical implications, shaping your public image between right and wrong. Choosing one side or the other will not penalize you; instead, each will give access to different features, especially during events. You’ll be free to decide what kind of Youtuber you want to be.

[b]Inspiration as a resource[/b]
Take a break. As humans, our capacity to work has limits. A new system will be added to break the endless loop of recording videos, forcing you to take rests either at home or by visiting outside locations. While it may sound restrictive, we assure you it will not be overly intrusive.

[b]New video types[/b]
The different types of videos in the game will be more faithful to real life. New video types will be added and some existing ones will be replaced.
[list]
[*] Vlogs: talk about rumors and news obtained at events. They can be recorded anywhere.
[*] Interviews: interview famous characters at events.
[*] Other types currently in development include unboxings, speedruns, reactions to other users’ videos, and more.
[/list]
[b]New online podcast recording minigame[/b]
Team up with your friends and record a podcast-style video in an entirely new minigame.

[b]New thumbnail rating system[/b]
Your creativity will no longer be limited by the rating system.

[b]Changes to the strike system[/b]
Managing strikes will now be more fun and challenging, with stronger effects on your results, including the option to pay bribes in shady corners to cancel strikes.

[b]Subscribers aligned with brands[/b]
Your subscribers will now be fans of specific brands and will prefer content related to those brands. They will penalize you if you don’t meet their expectations.

[b]Improved brand relationships[/b]
Managing your relationships with brands will be more important, as this will determine access to the events they organize.

[b]Changes to assignments[/b]
Assignments will now be obtained by interacting with NPCs in events.

[b]New NPCs[/b]
Some of your favorite characters from Youtubers Life 2 will return. While you won’t be able to build friendships with them, they will offer special missions.

All these features are still work in progress and may change as development continues or based on your feedback, so we encourage you to share your ideas with us.

The game is still in Early Access, precisely so we can listen to your opinions and improve aspects that aren’t as fun as they should be. As you can see, we are fully committed to development, and it is not our intention to abandon the game—in fact, quite the opposite: we want it to become the best experience possible.

Also, don’t forget that we have an[b] [url=https://discord.com/invite/DK77SXCurJ]official Discord channel[/url][/b], a space designed for you to share your gameplay experiences, ask questions, exchange tips with other users, and send us your suggestions and ideas directly to keep improving the game together.

Thank you very much for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Update 0.10.2
notes.content:
Hello Youtubers Life community,

We are happy to announce that a new [b]version 0.10.2[/b] of Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together! is now available.

We continue to work closely with you to improve the game during Early Access, and this update incorporates many of your suggestions, as well as polishing multiple aspects of the game.

This time, we have focused on improving overall stability, fixing important bugs, and adding systems that help create a more complete, comfortable, and fun experience for everyone.

[b]What does this update include?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Steam achievements[/b]
We've added achievements integrated into Steam. Now you can unlock rewards by completing certain milestones within the game. It's one more step toward recognizing your progress as a content creator.
[*] [b]User reporting system[/b]
We've enabled the ability to report inappropriate behavior directly from the user profile. We want to build a safer and more respectful social environment, and this tool will allow us to act faster when something goes wrong.
[*] [b]New ranking system on NewTube[/b]
We have redesigned how your position in the NewTube ranking is calculated. From now on, each video posted will add or subtract points based on its quality, measured by its star rating:

0 stars → - 5 points
1 star → - 3 points
2 stars → - 1 point
3 stars → + 1 point
4 stars → + 3 points
5 stars → +5 points

In addition, the Glitch ranking now shows the golden minute, highlighting the moment with the highest audience each day.
[/list]
[b]Other fixes and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs in the darts game.
[*] Fixed several issues in the streaming lobby.
[*] Fixed game covers.
[*] Improved the VOD mini-game.
[*] Fixed bugs when editing the house.
[*] Fixed the problem of employee furniture disappearing.
[*] Taylor is back in the game.
[*] Fixed the scriptwriter's bonus icons.
[*] The creator code now works correctly.
[*] Fixed several chat bugs.
[*] Adjusted the Challenge event texts.
[*] Fixed scriptwriter videos that were not displaying images.
[*] Fixed negative values in brand contracts.
[*] Employees no longer generate videos with random scores.
[*] Fixed star ratings for videos.
[*] Fixed visual error in the pool.
[*] Improved placement of wall pennant.
[*] Fixed texts that were not displaying correctly in the video editing screen.
[*] Fixed camera movement with right click.
[*] Fixed the bored status tooltip.
[*] Various fixes to the social relationship system.
[*] Renewed the hard drive screen.
[*] Reviewed and corrected some letter texts.
[*] Improved error messages when starting the game.
[*] Fixed Rikko's face animation.
[*] Photos now display correctly on the supertag screen.
[*] Lights automatically turn off when sleeping, and the character gets up on their own when they recover energy.
[*] Added pagination to the friends screen.
[*] New talent tips in video comments.
[/list]
Thank you for continuing to be an active part of this community. Every suggestion, report, or comment counts and drives us to keep improving.

If you're enjoying the game, a positive review on Steam helps us a lot to give visibility to the project and continue developing new features and content.

We continue working to make Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together! the best creator simulator we've ever made.

See you online!

notes.title: Update 0.9.1
notes.content:
Dear Youtubers Life players,

Thank you once again for joining us on this exciting journey that is Youtubers Life 3 – Stream Together!

As you know, we're currently in Early Access because we want to build this game together with you, listening to your feedback and improving day by day.

We’re excited to bring you a new update: version 0.9.1 is now available!

This patch includes multiple improvements, community-requested changes, and adjustments to make the gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

[b]UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New game modes during streaming:[/b] Auto, Competitive, and Training.

Auto Mode: Boosts your followers' morale but doesn't generate video content, income, or streamer rank progression.

Competitive Mode: Compete against 3 real players in a free-for-all multiplayer match.

Single Player: Play matches against NPCs to practice and earn rewards.

[*] [b]1v1 matches for beginner streamer rank.[/b]
When you're at the "Novice" streamer rank, streaming matches will be 1v1. Once you reach the "Aspirant" rank, matches will revert to 4-player format.

[*] [b]Changes to Recording Components[/b]
Recording components can now be repaired. The ability to repair recording components has been added from the home editing screen.

Recording components are now sorted by room, not by distance as before.

[*] [b]Brand contract improvements[/b]
Some contracts have been reviewed and adjusted based on the player's current progress in the game.

[*] [b]Major Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed multiple issues that could result in lost progress.

Fixed various house editing bugs.

Improvements to employee management.
[/list]

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced social relationship system.
[*] Updated text localization.
[*] Lamps and similar items now default to being turned on.
[*] Server requests are now canceled if player actions make them unnecessary.
[*] Improved data exchange performance with the server.
[*] Adjustments to mini-stories.
[*] Visual updates in the house decoration screen.
[*] Stream automation tweaks.
[*] Clothing balance adjustments.
[*] Improved server connection performance.
[*] Adjustments to available actions with other players.
[*] Autosave triggered when finishing house editing.
[*] Autosave triggered when entering an event.
[*] New streaming reward icons.
[*] Streaming card balancing.
[*] Various quest tweaks.
[*] Private duel changes: no extra rewards.
[*] Story quest adjustments.
[*] Shield Totem nerfed.
[*] Hot Tub card nerfed.
[*] Correct currency now shown when buying items at events.
[*] Some furniture now activates more tags in Photo Mode.
[*] Furniture highlights for new items now disappear after 1 minute.
[*] Video editing minigame difficulty adjusted for high-level Newtubers.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] MrRikko’s final mission now completes at 50M.
[*] Fixed infinite component repair exploit.
[*] Minor issues fixed in the painting mode.
[*] Photo score calculation fixed.
[*] "Insufficient funds" messages added for event tickets and strike fine payments.
[*] Fixed resolution selection errors.
[*] Safety checks for closing screens/popups before full load.
[*] Fixed input lock after taking a photo.
[*] Fixed input lock when opening/closing popups.
[*] Wardrobe-related bugs fixed.
[*] Instalife screen issues fixed.
[*] House decoration bugs resolved.
[*] Dart minigame round change errors fixed.
[*] Fixed calendar screen item display issues for events.
[*] Fixed various brand contract issues.
[*] Fixed multiple Taylor quest issues.
[*] Fixed physics behavior of certain hairstyles.
[*] Fixed bug when closing contracts after goals were met.
[*] Fixed local cache issues with game saves.
[*] Crash when loading item icons that the player doesn’t own.
[*] Crash when loading a disconnected player during a multiplayer event.
[*] Crash in house decoration with a broken recording component.
[*] Crash when closing the shop screen with a selected item.
[*] Crash when rapidly opening/closing another player’s profile.
[*] Crash when not selecting an emoji during a VOD.
[*] Crash when starting the next VOD round without available reactions.
[*] Crash when closing a VOD mid-round with reactions left.
[*] Crash during the friendship level-up minigame with another player.
[*] Crash during “kiss” or “hug” actions if one player disconnects.
[*] Crash when removing a player from an interactive object during an event if they're disconnected.
[*] Crash in the Invaders minigame when quitting as an enemy is hit.
[*] Crash when displaying a disconnected player.
[*] Crash displaying recording component icon after closing the screen.
[*] Crash displaying a console icon after closing the screen.
[*] Crash when finishing clip editing with one still selected.
[*] Crash when playing a card at the exact moment a streaming turn ends.
[*] Crash when showing a completed quest.
[*] Crash when receiving a multiplayer notification.
[/list]

We’re continuing to work on more content, improvements, and new features. As always, your support means the world to us! If you’re enjoying the game, a positive review on Steam really helps us move forward as a studio and continue improving Youtubers Life 3.

Thanks for being part of the community!

notes.title: Update 0.9.0
notes.content:
Dear Youtubers Life players,

Thank you for your support during the launch of Youtubers Life 3 - Stream together.

As you know, [b]we have published the game in Early Access[/b] so that together with the whole community and with your feedback, we can improve this new edition of the saga.

We have listened to you and as we don't want to wait to implement the first changes, [b]the 0.9.0 update[/b] of the game is already available. The first of several that will arrive in the coming days and weeks.

Details of the update:

[list]
[*] [b]Streaming will become optional:[/b] An additional button has been created on the streaming genre selection screen, which is “Automate”. This new feature allows the streaming mechanics to be completely optional. This option does increase subscriber morale, but it does not generate any videos or give any money, nor does it increase the streamer rank.

We can advance that next week there will be a new update with a third mode in Glitch. The game mode against bots, which will have the same rewards as the online mode, but without playing with other real users, nor participate in the ranking. It will be possible to solve the rounds quickly so that the games have a shorter duration.

[*] [b]Advanced totems:[/b] The most powerful totems are now only available in games of higher ranks, as is the case of the totem that allows the use of infinite skills. This measure aims to maintain a balance in the early stages of the game and offer progression to more advanced players.

[*] [b]Improved matchmaking:[/b] To improve fairness in multiplayer matches, the matchmaking system has been adjusted to be more restrictive, segmented more strictly according to the player's rank. In case there are no available players of that rank, bots will join the game.

[*] [b]Improvements in the server:[/b] Improvements have been applied in the server for a greater fluency of this one.

[*] [b]Other improvements and bug fixes:[/b] Other improvements have been implemented and several bugs have been detected and fixed, here are the most important ones:
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b] 
[list]
[*] New better paying jobs available.
[*] Fixed finance screen.
[*] Know in which events are your friends from the player profile.
[*] Newtube badges cannot be sold.
[*] Improvements in the video recording mini-game.
[*] Access to the game settings from the pause screen.
[*] Marks and contracts adapted to Newtube ranking.
[/list]

[b]Bugs fixed: [/b]
[list]
[*] Errors and low performance in the Instalife screen.
[*] Errors in the edition of the house with multiple objects.
[*] Errors in social interactions.
[*] Errors when publishing a video.
[*] Errors associated with event items.
[*] Errors during the streaming mini-game.
[*] Loss of photos of friends.
[*] Online players going through furniture.
[*] Errors of assignments that could not be completed.
[*] Errors related to agreements with brands and contracts.
[*] Various bugs in UI.
[/list]

We are still working to bring you more updates soon. All support is welcome, so if you are enjoying the game, a positive review on Steam always helps us as a studio to keep working and improving the game.

Thank you and we hope you continue to enjoy Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together!
